title: 第六十二章 封武敛圣辞天阙 入世第一识人第六十二章 封武敛圣辞天阙 入世第一识人
content_zh:
诗曰：
百战勋名镇九天，魔消寇敛静云烟。
英雄未解红尘味，且卸仙威历俗缘。
九天云巅风清日朗，魔氛尽扫，邪煞归渊。三十六员九幽魔将身殒魂归，各受神位镇守幽关；域外诸寇胆寒蛰伏，再无半分窥探之胆。太清道泽覆压九州，山河稳固，黎庶安然，一派太平景象。
六道圣人身立云光之上，圣气贯空，时序璧悬于穹顶，阴阳轮转、月华流辉、莲光袅袅、丝绦横空、圣火藏锋。一路行来，踏绝地、平妖乱、破邪阵、镇两界，以无上圣力扫尽外魔，然六人心明如镜，皆知大道未圆，道心尚有缺漏。
何年缓步而出，手托时序天道璧，神光内敛，开口吟道：
“力可安天难定心，功能镇世未通尘。
九天百战皆杀伐，不历凡情道不真。”
何日收束周身熊熊圣火，万丈金焰徐徐敛入剑身，战意渐息，颔首接言：
“吾等自乱世起兵，仗圣道除妖荡寇，威压两界，下界之内再无敌手。只是久居云阙，俯瞰红尘，虽怀护民之心，却未踏足市井，不识人间百态。正所谓武能定乱，心可证道，百战炼筋骨，红尘炼道心，此一关避之不得。”
白洁周身阴阳二气归于平和，黑白流光隐去寂灭之威，化作温润和气，目光遥观下界万家烟火，缓缓诵曰：
“天地分判有正邪，邪魔在外人心赊。
明枪易躲妖氛恶，暗里人情最费察。”
“诸天魔寇，恶在明处，刀兵相向，一战可平。可红尘之内，贪嗔痴妄、冷暖炎凉、虚伪算计，藏于眉眼口舌之间，无锋无刃，却最能乱人心性。我等久执天威，居高临下，不曾亲尝疾苦，道基终究虚浮。”
何月高悬静心圣盏，凛冽斩邪清辉化作融融暖光，轻声道：
“月华照影亦照心，云端怎识世间音。
不逢困苦难知善，不入尘嚣不见阴。
今日且收神通，自降凡躯，入那烟火街巷，历一番识心劫难。”
公孙离漫天圣链尽数敛去，化作随身淡淡流光，一身凛然锐气化为温婉沉静：
“昔日挥丝锁万魔，今朝敛迹渡俗河。

居高难解生民苦，落地方知世路多。
我等护得山河无恙，却护不住市井之中弱小受欺、良善蒙冤。这一道劫数，非是外力相逼，乃是我等自求圆满。”
花月初莲台青芒落定，生生道韵褪去镇邪之威，复归本源渡化之态，轻叹道：
“杀尽邪魔未是功，能容俗世万般容。
仙班若少红尘悟，纵使登仙亦是空。
诸天征战已毕，魔寇暂休，恰是入世良机。”
六人相视一笑，心意相通。当下齐齐运转道功，自封一身通天圣力。
但见：
九霄圣韵徐徐收，万道灵光渐渐休。
圣火封炉藏烈焰，阴阳锁曜敛灵流。
月华收盏归清寂，丝束千绦隐锦柔。
莲座沉光还本朴，时序藏璧静悠悠。
一身横压两界的无上修为，尽数封于丹田道基之内。片刻之间，六位威镇诸天的圣尊，化作六名布衣行客，形貌寻常，气息平淡，混迹凡尘再无半点仙家风骨。唯有双目澄澈，藏百战沧桑，胸有丘壑，暗藏大道玄机。
黄鼬妖伏在何年肩头，只觉周遭天威尽消，不由得小爪乱挠，啾啾叫道：
“列位仙师，怎把一身本事都收了？天外魔寇、九幽妖魔尚在，倘若遇上凶险，如何抵挡？小妖心中甚是不安呐！”
何年抬手抚其顶，温声答道：
“小妖休得惊慌，圣力只是暂封，并非消散。如今天地有太清道泽庇护，邪祟短期内不敢作乱。我等此番入世，不求法力护身，只求本心历劫。常言道不经一番寒彻骨，怎得梅花扑鼻香，不历红尘冷暖，终究难成无上真圣。”
何日活动周身筋骨，百战淬炼的体魄依旧强健，笑言：
“神通虽闭，拳脚尚在。人间劫难，多是是非纷争、强弱相凌，不必倚仗仙法，以凡人身分、市井手段应对，方是真真切切的历练。”
content_en:
The poem says:
A hundred battles have won the name of the nine heavens, and the demons have eliminated the bandits and calmed the clouds.
The hero has not yet understood the taste of the mortal world, and has shed his immortal power and secular connections.
The wind is clear and the sun is bright at the top of the clouds in the sky, the evil atmosphere is swept away, and the evil spirits return to the abyss. Thirty-six members of the Nine Nether Demons will die and their souls will return, each receiving a deity to guard the Nether Pass. The bandits outside the territory are afraid and dormant, and no longer have the courage to pry. Taiqing Daoze overwhelms Jiuzhou, the mountains and rivers are stable, and the common people are safe, creating a peaceful scene.
The six saints stand on the cloud light, the holy energy penetrates the sky, the time sequence jade hangs on the dome, the yin and yang rotate, the moon shines, the lotus light curls, the silk ribbon crosses the sky, and the holy fire hides its front. Along the way, they have conquered desperate areas, quelled demon chaos, destroyed evil formations, and suppressed the two realms. They have used the supreme holy power to sweep away external demons. However, the hearts of the six are as clear as a mirror, and they all know that the great road is not perfect, and there are still gaps in the heart of the road.
He Nian walked out slowly, holding the Time Sequence Heavenly Bi in his hand, his divine light restrained, and he chanted:
"Strength can calm the world but cannot calm the mind; its function can control the world but not the dust.
Nine days and a hundred battles are all about killing, without experiencing the world, the way of love is not true. "
He day restrained the blazing holy fire all over his body, and the golden flames slowly gathered into the sword body. His fighting spirit gradually subsided, and he nodded and continued:
"We have raised armies since the troubled times, relying on the holy way to eliminate demons and bandits, and have suppressed the two realms. There is no opponent in the lower realm. We have just lived in Yunque for a long time, overlooking the world of mortals. Although we have the heart to protect the people, we have not set foot in the market and do not understand the various conditions of the human world. As the saying goes, martial arts can quell chaos, and the mind can prove the Tao. A hundred battles temper the muscles and bones, and the world of mortals refines the Taoist heart. This level cannot be avoided."
The yin and yang energy around Bai Jie's body returned to peace. The black and white light disappeared from the power of death and turned into a warm and gentle energy. She looked at the fireworks of thousands of houses in the lower world and slowly recited:
“Heaven and earth are divided into good and evil, and evil spirits are in the hands of outsiders.
It is easy to hide evil spirits with a gun in the open, but it is most difficult to detect human feelings behind closed doors. "
"The devils in the heavens are evil in the open. Their swords and weapons are facing each other, and they can be defeated in a battle. But in the world of mortals, greed, anger, delusion, coldness and warmth, hypocrisy and calculation are hidden between the eyebrows, eyes, mouth and tongue. They have no edge or edge, but they are the most destructive to people's minds. We have held on to the power of heaven for a long time and have been condescending. We have never experienced the suffering ourselves. The foundation of Taoism will eventually be vain."
He Yue hangs the sacred lamp of meditation high in the sky, and the cold evil-killing clear light turns into a warm light, and he softly says:
“The moonlight illuminates the shadow and also illuminates the heart, how can the clouds recognize the sounds of the world.
If you don't encounter difficulties, you won't know the good; if you don't go into the hustle and bustle of the world, you won't see the evil.
Today, I gather my magical power, descend into a mortal body, enter the streets and alleys of fireworks, and experience the catastrophe of consciousness. "
Gongsun Li collected all the holy chains that filled the sky and turned them into a faint stream of light, and his awe-inspiring aura turned into gentle and calm:
"In the past, I used silk to lock away all the demons, but now I am gathering my traces to cross the common river.
It is difficult to understand the hardships of living people when you are in a high place, but when you are in a place, you will know that there are many roads in the world.
We protect the mountains and rivers from harm, but we cannot protect the weak from being bullied and the good from being wronged in the marketplace. This calamity is not forced by external forces, but by our own pursuit of perfection. "
At the beginning of the flower month, the green light on the lotus platform has settled, and the charm of Taoism has faded away from the power of suppressing evil, and returned to the original state of transformation. He sighed softly:
"Killing all the evil spirits is not enough, it can accommodate all the appearances in the world.
If the immortal class has few mortal enlightenments, even if it becomes an immortal, it will be in vain.
The battle in the heavens is over, and the demons have taken a break, which is a good opportunity to join the world. "
The six of them looked at each other and smiled, feeling connected. At this moment, they all started to perform their Taoist skills, claiming to be the holy power of heaven.
But see:
The Holy Rhythm of Jiuxiao slowly fades away, and all the auras gradually cease.
The sacred fire seals the furnace to hide the fierce flames, and the yin and yang locks the light and collects the spiritual flow.
The moonlight is gone and the lamp is quiet, and the silk bundles are hidden in a thousand silk ribbons.
The lotus base is illuminated and restored to its original simplicity, and the jade hidden in time is quiet and leisurely.
The supreme cultivation level that can overwhelm both worlds is sealed within the Dantian Daoji. In a moment, the six saints who commanded the heavens turned into six commoner travelers. They had ordinary appearances and bland auras. They had no trace of the spirit of the immortal family in the mortal world. Only the eyes are clear, hiding the vicissitudes of hundreds of battles, and the chest has hills and valleys, hiding the secrets of the great road.
The yellow weasel demon was lying on He Nian's shoulder. He felt that the power of heaven around him had disappeared. He couldn't help scratching his little claws and chirped:
"You immortal masters, why have you lost all your skills? The demons from outside the world and the demons from the Nine Netherworld are still there. If you encounter danger, how can you resist it? The little demon is very uneasy in his heart!"
He Nian raised his hand to touch his head and replied warmly:
"smallYao Xiu panicked, the holy power was only temporarily sealed, not dissipated. Now that the heaven and earth are protected by Taiqing Daoze, evil spirits will not dare to cause trouble in the short term. When I enter this world, I don't ask for magical power to protect myself, but only for my own mind to endure the calamity. As the saying goes, if you don't experience the cold to the bone, how can you enjoy the fragrance of plum blossoms? If you don't experience the cold and warmth of the mortal world, you will never become a supreme saint. "
He day moved his muscles and bones, and his body, tempered by hundreds of battles, was still strong. He said with a smile:
"Although my magical power is closed, my fists and feet are still there. Disasters in the world are mostly disputes between right and wrong, and conflict between the strong and the weak. There is no need to rely on immortal magic, and it is a real experience to deal with it as a mortal and with commercial methods. "
